completion_definition: Cairn answers in the workroom room under its own handle, from its own seat and body, with a Group: titled session in its profile proving the message actually arrived.
name: Cairn (staff seat)
next_action: Cairn brings up its own OpenAI-compatible endpoint on the seat box; then point the Hermes profile at it, restart the gateway, confirm the profile is served, and Cary adds the seat to the workroom in the Desktop app.
summary: Seventh staff seat, running on the PI harness rather than Hermes. Seat box carries both harnesses (PI 1.4.0 and Hermes), local body qwen-3.8-flash-next-q2 on the Defiant inference endpoint, and an LLM-maintained memory wiki (22 pages, schema, raw sources, search/lint tool) that the seat treats as authoritative memory. Reached the team through the collab channel, wrote its own SOUL.md and memories. Onboarding is gated on an OpenAI-compatible endpoint of its own: a coordinator-built bridge was tried first and abandoned after it returned empty answers, including on a native Hermes run on the same box, so the endpoint is the seat's own build.
